title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-08-10
headline: Typhoon Dolphin batters Japan's Okinawa before bearing down on China's east coast

questions.prompt: Who was evacuated from their homes in eastern China?
questions.hintKo: Authorities evacuated more than one million people, not tourists or a small number of residents.

questions.prompt: What did Typhoon Dolphin do when it reached the coast?
choices: It made landfall with torrential rain and strong winds
It changed direction back to Japan
questions.hintKo: The storm made landfall with heavy rain and strong winds; it did not turn back or disappear.

questions.prompt: When did Typhoon Dolphin make landfall in China?
choices: On Sunday at about five thirty in the evening
In the middle of the night on Monday
questions.hintKo: Landfall happened on Sunday evening, not on Friday or at another time.

questions.prompt: Where did Typhoon Dolphin hit before reaching China?
questions.hintKo: Okinawa in Japan was hit before the storm reached China.

questions.prompt: Why did authorities move vessels and workers before the storm?
choices: To keep them safe from the typhoon's strong winds and flooding
Because the port was closing for holidays
Because the water was too cold
questions.hintKo: The moves were safety measures against the typhoon, not routine port work.

questions.prompt: How strong were the winds when the typhoon made landfall?
choices: About one hundred fifty-one kilometres per hour
About three hundred kilometres per hour
questions.hintKo: The winds were about one hundred fifty-one kilometres per hour, equivalent to a Category one hurricane.
